<translate>
<!--T:7-->
'''Glinds''' are an ancient race with lilac skin, almost identical to [[Special:MyLanguage/Human|Humans]] at first sight. Their ki carries a divine trace that slips past scouters and the senses of mortal warriors, and they show no mercy to anyone weaker than them, crushing their foes' ability to recover. In DragonMineZ every part of the Glind racial skill is passive, and Glinds are the only race with the '''God''' 3D aura style and the two '''Time Power''' forms.
</translate>

<translate>
== Overview and strengths == <!--T:8-->

<!--T:9-->
* '''Hidden ki.''' [[Special:MyLanguage/Ki Sense|Ki Sense]], Scouters and [[Special:MyLanguage/Instant Transmission|Instant Transmission]] can't find you, unless the seeker is another Glind, has unlocked or is using a God Form, or is under Kami's Blessing.
* '''Divine senses.''' Your Divine Ki lets you sense players in a God Form, such as [[Special:MyLanguage/Super Saiyan God Ritual|Super Saiyan God]], who are hidden from everyone without god ki.
* '''Celestial Body.''' Faster health, Ki and stamina regeneration, and a better Meditation dodge chance.
* '''Divine Punishment.''' Your hits cut the healing of the players you hit.
* '''Light and Darkness.''' Bonus damage against players of the opposite alignment, and always against non-player foes.
* '''Nothing to activate.''' Every racial trait works on its own.
</translate>

<translate>
== Racial skill == <!--T:10-->
</translate>
{{Config|General Server Config|racialSkills.glind}}
<translate>
<!--T:11-->
Every part of the Glind racial skill is passive: there is nothing to select or activate.
</translate>
{| class="wikitable"
! <translate><!--T:12--> Part</translate> !! <translate><!--T:13--> What it does</translate>
|-
| <translate><!--T:14--> '''Divine Ki'''</translate> || <translate><!--T:15--> Ki Sense, Scouters and Instant Transmission cannot find you unless the seeker is a Glind with Divine Ki too, has unlocked a '''God Form''' or is in one, or is under '''Kami's Blessing'''. Lock On still works. Divine Ki also counts as god ki: you can find players in a God Form (such as [[Special:MyLanguage/Super Saiyan God Ritual|Super Saiyan God]]) with Ki Sense, lock on to them and reach them with Instant Transmission.</translate>
|-
| <translate><!--T:16--> '''Celestial Body'''</translate> || <translate><!--T:17--> Your health, Ki and stamina regeneration are '''25%''' higher, and your Meditation dodge chance against melee attacks is '''50%''' higher.</translate>
|-
| <translate><!--T:18--> '''Divine Punishment'''</translate> || <translate><!--T:19--> Your attacks reduce the healing of players you hit by '''20%''' for '''6 seconds'''. Your Healing Reduction skill and enchantment stack on top at '''50%''' effectiveness, up to '''40%''' in total.</translate>
|-
| <translate><!--T:20--> '''Light and Darkness'''</translate> || <translate><!--T:21--> Deal '''10%''' more damage to players of the opposite alignment ('''15%''' against Frost Demons, '''5%''' against Majins): with '''25''' alignment or less you punish players at '''60''' or more, and with '''75''' or more you punish players at '''40''' or less. Against any non-player foe you always deal '''7.5%''' more damage.</translate>
|}

<translate>
<!--T:22-->
* '''Kami's Blessing''' is given by Dende to players with good alignment (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Effects|Effects]]).
* Light and Darkness depends on your [[Special:MyLanguage/Alignment|alignment]]: a Glind between 26 and 74 alignment gets no bonus against players, only the bonus against non-player foes.
</translate>

<translate>
== Transformations == <!--T:23-->
</translate>
{{Main|Transformations}}
<translate>
<!--T:43-->
''Level'' is the level of the form skill (Super Forms or Legendary Forms) that unlocks the form, and ''TP cost'' is the price of that level. Each form after the first of its group also needs '''25% mastery''' on the previous one. Multipliers are the defaults at 0% mastery and grow up to 1.5 times at 100% mastery. ''Ki drain'' is the base upkeep per tick; see [[Special:MyLanguage/Transformations#Energy consumption while transformed|energy consumption]].
</translate>

<translate>
=== Time Power === <!--T:45-->

<!--T:46-->
Glinds get two alternative forms on the third Legendary level. Both '''Time Power''' forms unlock at that level and each needs '''25% mastery on Dark King''': you can use either one, or both. They share '''50%''' of the mastery they gain with each other.
</translate>

<translate>
== Appearance == <!--T:47-->
</translate>
{{Main|Character Customization}}
<translate>
<!--T:48-->
* '''Model:''' the Human body and face parts with Glind colors. Glinds can't use their Minecraft skin.
* '''Eyes:''' besides the human eye styles, Glinds have their own Glind eye style, the first one in the '''Eyes''' list.
* '''Head:''' Glinds wear '''ears''' (head part <code>ears1</code>), which can be combined with a hairstyle.
* '''Hair:''' yes. Glinds can pick any hairstyle preset and design their own styles in the hair editor.
* '''Gender:''' yes, with male and female models, including the Transcended form.
* '''Body types:''' 2 for each gender, with body type 1 as the default. The second male body type has slim arms.
* '''Aura:''' Glinds can pick the exclusive '''3D: God''' aura style, a constantly shifting flame.
* '''Forms:''' several forms change your look. '''Absorption''' adds a white outline. '''Dark King''' gives you a bulkier body, crimson hair (your SSJ2 hairstyle slot), red eyes on black sclera, a red outline and a red and black aura. '''Time Power: Dark King''' has its own model with red markings, the same red eyes on black sclera and a black outline, and '''Time Power: Realm of Light''' a white outline. With the '''3D: Sparking''' aura style, the Absorption aura has a white outer edge, and the dark auras of Transcended, True Form and Time Power: Dark King a black one.
</translate>

<translate>
== Configuration == <!--T:49-->
</translate>
<translate>
<!--T:50-->
The four parts of the racial skill are tuned in the <code>glind</code> section of <code>racialSkills</code> in <code>general-server.json</code>, including the alignment thresholds and damage bonuses of Light and Darkness, and Divine Ki can be switched off on its own (<code>divineKi</code>). The Super Forms TP ladder is in <code>races/glind/character.json</code>, and each form's values are in its form file.
</translate>
{{See also|General Server Config|Custom Races|Custom Forms}}
